pages.text: $(l)Ascension$() is a talent tab only bosses can fill. No experience counts.$(br2)Your first great Wildlands boss (Ancient Remnant, Maledictus or the Leviathan) opens it and gives your first point: your $(l)Fate$().

$(li)Wildlands boss: a $(l)Fate$()$(li)The Harbinger: a $(l)Transformation$() of one spell$(li)Monstrosity and Ignis: two $(l)Deepenings$()$(li)Ender Guardian: your $(l)Ultimate$()$(li)Ender Dragon and the Wither: two $(l)Empowerments$() of it
pages.title: The Ladder

pages.text: Each class has two Fates. Taking one locks the other, and each has a $(l)drawback$(). You get one of two Transformations and two of three Deepenings.$(br2)An $(item)Orb of Oblivion$() resets it all; points are kept.$(br2)Rogue, Warrior, Priest and Paladin have Fates now. Other classes keep their points until theirs arrive.
pages.title: Choosing

pages.text: Your first melee hit after Vanish or Shadow Step deals +150% damage.$(br2)Drawback: -20% max health.$(br2)Ultimate: Thousand Cuts: blades hit every enemy within 6 blocks, every hit critical.
pages.title: Nightblade (Rogue)

pages.text: Every melee hit adds a stack of Fatal Poison (up to 5).$(br2)Drawback: -20% melee damage.$(br2)Ultimate: Plague Bloom: a toxic cloud follows you for 8 seconds.
pages.title: Plaguefang (Rogue)

pages.text: +30% max health, +4 armor. Charge makes enemies attack you.$(br2)Drawback: -15% movement and attack speed.$(br2)Ultimate: Colossus: 10 seconds larger, unmovable, taking half damage.
pages.title: Juggernaut (Warrior)

pages.text: Mortal Strike deals double damage below 35% health; kills reset Charge.$(br2)Drawback: -30% healing received.$(br2)Ultimate: Rampage: for 8 seconds every kill resets your cooldowns.
pages.title: Reaver (Warrior)

pages.text: Overhealing becomes a barrier. +30% healing power.$(br2)Drawback: -50% holy damage.$(br2)Ultimate: Dawnfall: your heals land on every ally near you, and death holds off once.
pages.title: Lightbinder (Priest)

pages.text: 40% of the holy damage you deal heals the most injured ally near you.$(br2)Drawback: -30% healing power on your heals.$(br2)Ultimate: Wrath of Dawn: pillars of light strike and heal.
pages.title: Zealot (Priest)

pages.text: +20% max health. Shield blocks heal you and pull aggro.$(br2)Drawback: -25% attack damage.$(br2)Ultimate: Bastion of Light: a dome where allies take 60% less damage.
pages.title: Bulwark (Paladin)

pages.text: Melee hits add holy damage from your healing power.$(br2)Drawback: -4 armor, -20% healing power.$(br2)Ultimate: Avatar of Light: wings, +30% attack damage, shockwaves.
pages.title: Crusader (Paladin)
